Your RoleReporting directly to the HR Director, you will act as an all-round HR Generalist driving our "soft HR" strategy across the organization. You will take ownership of defined projects with clear milestones and deliverables to streamline HR operations and cultivate a healthy, open workplace culture.
Beyond initial design, your core focus will be the practical rollout, end-to-end implementation, and continuous follow-up of essential HR processes, ensuring that initiatives like onboarding, performance management, and learning & development don't just exist on paper, but are actively adopted, monitored, and sustained across all teams.
This is an ideal role for a pragmatic HR professional with the drive and capacity to step up into a senior HR leadership position as Fanfinity expands.
 
 

• End-to-end Recruitment: Together with colleagues in the HR team, independently manage a selected portfolio of vacancies: from crafting engaging role profiles, screening CVs, conducting interviews, and securing top talent to match our growth pace. 

• New Hire Onboarding: Take personal ownership of the soft landing for your newly placed hires running structured check-ins and follow-ups to ensure a smooth integration. 

• Performance Management: Roll out, manage, and actively follow up on the performance management cycle, guiding managers and employees through goal-setting, continuous feedback habits, structured performance reviews and guide team leads through yearly wage review cycle. 

• Learning & Development: Identify organizational skill gaps, design practical development pathways, coordinate targeted training initiatives, and follow up on employee growth plans to foster continuous internal upskilling. 

• Trusted Advisory: Act as an approachable, trusted partner for employees and managers alike, offering practical guidance on day-to-day people topics while embedding a company-wide culture of open feedback, mutual trust, and transparent communication. 

• Employee Engagement & Retention: Drive initiatives that boost team morale, monitor employee sentiment, and execute proactive retention strategies across our departments. 

What You BringMust-Have Requirements:
 
 

• Proven Experience: Minimum of 3 years of relevant HR generalist experience, with demonstrable hands-on experience in recruitment, performance management and/or learning & development. 

• Languages: Full professional fluency in both Dutch and English (spoken and written); comfortable interviewing candidates, advising leadership, drafting documentation, and holding sensitive discussions in both languages. 

• Implementation & Follow-Up Track Record: Proven ability to not just design HR workflows, but to roll them out, ensure manager and team adoption, and maintain systematic follow-up. 

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or equivalent practical experience. 

• Project Delivery: Demonstrated capability to manage defined HR projects independently and hit clear milestones and deliverables.  

Who You Are:
 
 

• Hands-On & Pragmatic: You enjoy rolling up your sleeves to implement solutions. 

• Proactive & Autonomous: You find it stimulating to spot an inefficient workflow, devise a structured fix, and drive it through to complete execution without micro-management. 

• Strong Communicator: You build trust quickly, navigate difficult conversations with empathy, and know how to rally managers around new HR initiatives. 

• Growth-Oriented: You bring intellectual curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and the leadership potential required to step into a senior HR role as the company scales.

As a CE Truck Driver, you are responsible for checking delivery documents, ensuring accurate deliveries and handling products with care. Loading and unloading is mainly done using an electric pallet truck, limiting heavy physical work. There’s occasional work on Saturdays, between 8 AM. and 5 PM, in which case you get a day off during the week. You work independently, take pride in maintaining your vehicle and follow a schedule that is communicated in advance.

• Previous experience as a CE driver.
 
• Good communication skills in English, additional language skills are considered a plus.
 
• A responsible and independent attitude.
 
• A customer-friendly and professional approach.
